passages.original: Apud Eusebium lib. VII, cap. 50, concilii Antiocheni legitur epistola < Dionysio (romano) Maximo (qui Dionysio Alexandrino successerat) et omnibus ubicumque in orbe terrarum collegis episcopis, presbyteris, diacouis, et universæ Ecclesiæ catholicæ » inscripta, qua Paulus Samosatensis ab episcopatu depulsus, et in ejus locum Domnus suf- fectus renuntiatur.
passages.english: In Eusebius, book VII, chapter 30, there is read a letter of the council of Antioch, addressed "to Dionysius (of Rome), to Maximus (who had succeeded Dionysius of Alexandria), and to all our fellow bishops, presbyters and deacons everywhere in the world, and to the whole catholic Church", in which it is announced that Paul of Samosata has been driven from the episcopate and that Domnus has been put in his place.
passages.notes: The text reads "cap. 50"; the letter is in Eusebius, Ecclesiastical History VII.30, so "50" is probably a scanning error for "30", and I have translated "chapter 30". "diacouis" is read as "diaconis" (deacons) and "suf- fectus" as "suffectus".
